summary: The reader has finished an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis and recurrences, algorithm design (divide and conquer, the classical FFT idea), basic Turing machine complexity, discrete mathematics (binary and positional number systems, modular arithmetic, prime numbers, subsets), and the linear algebra and calculus that such a degree includes (vector spaces, subspaces, rank, matrices, inverse, real exponentials and logarithms). The reader has not studied algebraic structures beyond the basics, number theory beyond elementary modular arithmetic, numerical error analysis, or the research literature on fast integer multiplication.

known.name: Binary representation of integers
known.gloss: A nonnegative integer is written as a string of bits whose positions carry powers of two.

known.name: Positional radix and digit expansion
known.gloss: An integer is written in base b as digits times powers of b, and schoolbook addition and multiplication propagate carries between digits.

known.name: Logarithms and floor/ceiling
known.gloss: The base-2 logarithm lg n and the rounding functions floor and ceiling, used for bit lengths and sizes.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Integers are compared and added by their remainders modulo m, so indices wrap around cyclically.

known.name: Prime numbers and coprimality
known.gloss: Primes have no divisors but 1 and themselves, and coprime integers share no common factor.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Linear transformations of vector spaces are represented by matrices, composed by multiplication and undone by inverses.

known.name: Vector spaces, subspaces, dimension and rank
known.gloss: Subspaces, dimension of spans, and the rank of a matrix as the dimension of its image.

known.name: Permutations and permutation matrices
known.gloss: A permutation reorders a list of indices, and its matrix has exactly one 1 in each row and column.

known.name: Cartesian products and multidimensional arrays
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples of coordinates, stored in a linear order such as lexicographic order.

known.name: Divide and conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Cost of a recursive algorithm expressed via the cost of smaller subcalls and combination work.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform idea
known.gloss: The discrete Fourier transform of length 2^k is computed in O(N log N) arithmetic operations by layers of two-point butterflies.

known.name: Absolute value, norms and error bounds
known.gloss: The magnitude of numbers and vectors and elementary inequalities bounding sums and errors.

known.name: Dyadic rationals and fixed-point numbers
known.gloss: Numbers of the form integer over a power of two, represented with a fixed number of fractional bits.

known.name: XOR and bitwise operations
known.gloss: Bitwise exclusive-or of bit strings, addition modulo 2 coordinatewise.

known.name: Finite sets and subset operations
known.gloss: Basic set notation: subsets, intersections, cardinality, and the support of a function.

known.name: Euler's formula and unit circle
known.gloss: A complex number of modulus 1 is e^{iθ}, and e^{2πi/N} is a primitive N-th root of unity.

known.name: Worst-case running time and Turing machine step counting
known.gloss: Running time is the maximum number of machine steps over inputs of length n.

known.name: Gaussian elimination and triangular matrices
known.gloss: Matrices with zeros above the diagonal, and elimination by elementary row operations.
